reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "InfluxDB v1: InfluxDB v1.x maintenance ended in 2021", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: upgrade-blocked

consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if InfluxDB v1 metrics configuration (metrics.influxDB) is present in the static configuration.

proposed.statement: The InfluxDB v1 metrics provider configuration has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 and will prevent Traefik from starting if present.
